_README: FROZEN-RELEASE LEDGER (s114-D4, s219-D4(5)). One row per shipped release. Every field here is MEASURED by knowledge/_release/_gate_frozen_release.py --seed — never hand-typed. Editing a frozen surface means cutting a NEW release: change the files, re-seed, and BUMP that row's `version` in the same commit. Re-seeding without a bump is caught by the gate's laundering arm, which reads this file at the parent commit.
